pr_title: Fix references for GOST TLS 1.2 ciphersuite draft with rfc9189

issue_context.title: Usage of pre-RFC standard values for GOST signature schemes
issue_context.body:
The values for the GOST signature schemes seems to be out of date.
https://github.com/openssl/openssl/blob/7054fc1ca3945342777f588fba43b77f669509ad/ssl/ssl_local.h#L2206-L2207

Referencing the RFC diff (see section 5.):
https://author-tools.ietf.org/iddiff?url1=draft-smyshlyaev-tls12-gost-suites-04&url2=rfc9189&difftype=--html

Is it just a matter of updating them or are there any compatibility concerns?
comments:
Ok, thank you.

Given that the associated PR was closed due to compatibility concerns, I think this can just be closed

review_comments: @mattcaswell - is this likely to be an interop problem?
I don't know if @beldmit should be in the loop as well?
I stopped maintaining GOST because of personal reasons.
We could keep the existing values as well.
